verdict.rationale: Extend applies AI to the user's documents inside the product. It extracts structured values with per-field confidence scores and citations, can infer a schema at runtime, and lists a "Composer & Review Agent" on its pricing page. That is AI-generated output from user data, but it is extraction rather than true insights or suggestions, and the Composer/Review Agent appears only as a bare pricing-page label. Missing for 10: documented in-product insight or suggestion features (e.g., summaries, recommendations, or schema/config suggestions explained in docs), details of what Composer and the Review Agent actually suggest, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
